target_definition.metric: United States monthly all-items CPI change

graph_diagnosis.summary: Broad cooling in inflationary pressure can restrain consumer demand and business price increases, while housing and inflation-expectation pressure provide meaningful upside counterevidence.
weaknesses: The graph's direct measurement and downstream market-reaction nodes describe the realized release and are excluded from reusable reasoning.
Housing evidence concerns lagged shelter inflation and may not align precisely with a single monthly observation.

search_factors.why_search: Broad easing or reacceleration in component prices establishes the macro backdrop for the monthly index.
Demand moderation and restrained price-setting are the proposed transmission channel from cooling pressures to consumer prices.
Shelter can sustain all-items CPI pressure even when new-lease prices and other sectors cool.
An upside shift in household or market inflation expectations can support firmer price-setting despite otherwise cooling data.

checkpoints.mechanism: Cooling price pressure across sectors reduces the broad impetus for increases in consumer prices.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Check whether major CPI components and upstream cost measures are easing together.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Multiple major components accelerate at the same time.

checkpoints.mechanism: Softer demand or more restrained business price-setting transmits broad cooling into consumer-facing prices.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Compare demand indicators and component prices with reports of business pricing behavior.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Demand remains firm and businesses continue broad price increases.

checkpoints.mechanism: Lagged shelter inflation can keep a heavily weighted component elevated after new-lease conditions cool.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Track monthly shelter CPI alongside new-lease and rent measures.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Shelter inflation decelerates broadly in the published components.

checkpoints.mechanism: Upside inflation-expectation risk can encourage precautionary pricing or signal persistence in price pressure.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Review distributions, not only averages, in expectation surveys and market measures.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Expectation distributions and pricing indicators both ease.

checkpoints.mechanism: Component-level price changes aggregate into the published monthly all-items CPI index.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Use the published index level and component contributions to calculate and reconcile the monthly change.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: The component narrative does not reconcile to the published index movement.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Broadly lower inflation pressure can pass through demand and business pricing into softer monthly consumer-price growth.
applicability_conditions: Easing is present in sufficiently weighted components.
Businesses pass lower cost or demand pressure through to consumer prices.
failure_conditions: Shelter or other large components accelerate.
Price-setting remains disconnected from weaker demand.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: A lagged shelter component can offset easing in other prices when the all-items index is aggregated.
applicability_conditions: Shelter remains elevated relative to other components.
failure_conditions: New-lease cooling reaches the measured shelter component quickly.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: Lagged shelter inflation offsets broader disinflation.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Compare shelter's monthly contribution with the combined contribution from other major components.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: Upside expectation risk sustains price-setting despite current cooling.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Compare the upper tail of expectation surveys with realized services and goods price changes.

forecast_audit_questions: Are major CPI components cooling together or is easing narrowly concentrated?
Do demand indicators and business pricing reports support pass-through of lower pressure?
Is lagged shelter inflation offsetting easing elsewhere?
Have upside inflation expectations changed price-setting behavior?
Do published component contributions reconcile to the monthly all-items index?
